title: Spout helper resolution falls back to same-named executable on PATH
description: When the embedded helper and executable-adjacent helper are unavailable, the default spout-capture.exe name can be resolved from PATH.
impact: A same-user attacker who can influence PATH may cause the app to run an unintended local helper during Spout checks or capture.
attacker_view: Place or expose a same-named executable in a searched location and wait for helper checks/capture in an affected distribution or test environment.
recommendation: Do not use PATH fallback for the default helper name. Allow only embedded helper or executable-adjacent helper unless the user explicitly chooses a trusted absolute path.
verification: Add tests that ResolveSpoutHelperPath("spout-capture.exe") fails when embedded and adjacent helpers are unavailable even if PATH contains a candidate.

title: Windows fixed command launches rely on PATH resolution
description: Startup shortcut creation, shortcut reading, VRChat window-rect detection, and ffmpeg install helper invoke powershell.exe or winget by name.
impact: A local attacker who can influence command search path may cause an unintended executable to run with the user's privileges.
attacker_view: Abuse a polluted PATH or search path so an app feature resolves a malicious same-named executable.
recommendation: Resolve trusted absolute paths for PowerShell and winget, then execute those paths directly.
verification: Add tests or Windows verification showing a same-named executable on PATH is not used.

title: GitHub Actions use major version tags instead of commit SHA pinning
description: External GitHub Actions are referenced by major version tags. Release job permissions and signing secrets are otherwise separated.
impact: If an upstream Action tag or distribution is compromised, CI/Release code execution could be affected.
attacker_view: Compromise or move an external Action reference used by the workflow.
recommendation: Pin Actions to full commit SHAs, at least in the Release workflow, and use dependency automation for updates.
verification: Search workflows for major tag Action references and confirm Release paths use full SHA references.

title: Latest vulnerability database checks were not run locally
description: The local audit avoided active external network access, so vulnerability database-backed checks were not run locally.
impact: The local report may miss newly published dependency advisories.
attacker_view: Exploit a dependency vulnerability that has not been checked against the latest advisory database.
recommendation: Confirm CI/Release npm audit and govulncheck results before release.
verification: Run CI or execute npm audit and govulncheck in a network-approved environment.

title: Windows release artifact mitigations and signature were not locally verified
description: The local environment did not build or inspect Windows release artifacts.
impact: Artifact contents, Windows mitigations, SmartScreen behavior, and detached signature verification require separate release validation.
attacker_view: Abuse gaps in release verification if CI checks are skipped or ignored.
recommendation: Follow the release security checklist for each release and record asset/signature verification.
verification: Run the Release workflow and verify zip contents, detached signature, and helper commands.
